name: 붐볼
wear: White upper hemisphere and red lower hemisphere become glossy white chest and shoulder plates over red waist, hip and leg plates, divided by a thin black equatorial seam. Rounded shell arcs form panel edges; black eyebrow-like chevrons become small forehead-band and collar accents. Human skin, no spherical creature suit, no ball button or handheld sphere.
scene: On a deserted basalt induction-test platform at dusk, grounded slightly wide standing stance with face toward camera, both empty hands open beside thighs outside armor silhouette, full head and boots visible.
casual: At a secluded geothermal rock spa in winter midday sunlight, kneeling on a dry timber deck and opening a folded red towel with both hands clearly separate at opposite corners; steam and dark boulders behind, no people.
Fully lined white halter bikini top with secure wide underband, red high-waisted swim bottoms with full pelvis coverage, bare shoulders arms midriff and legs, tiny black chevron earrings.

On an empty futuristic music-festival rehearsal walkway at midnight, giving a small wave with one hand and keeping the other open beside her hip; circular stage lights and white-red light columns, no audience or signs.

Opaque white high-neck sleeveless short event dress with sculpted red waist panel, secure side-waist cutouts and red asymmetric knee-length overskirt over fitted opaque shorts, black ankle boots and tiny chevron brooch; bare arms shoulders waist and legs.

At a bright greenhouse seed-sorting table on a quiet morning, seated side profile separating large berry seeds between two shallow ceramic trays with both complete hands unobstructed on the tabletop; diffuse green light and plants behind.
Opaque red sleeveless wrap crop blouse with a secure V neckline, white high-waisted linen midi skirt below crop, bare arms shoulders and waist gap; tiny silver circle hair clip.
